about: What Legion 3D is built on top of: globals, functions, DOM hooks, endpoints and events of the game site. Static (scripts/drift.mjs, no browser): 'keys' = every key must be a real top-level key of the `window.<obj> = {` literal in 'file' (comments ignored); 'global' = the UMD/global module in 'file' exports those keys (run in node:vm) or, failing that, assigns window.<name>; otherwise 're' (JS regex source) must match 'file' (any script if omitted). Runtime (src/net/contract.ts: at boot in the extension and in e2e/contract.mjs): 'keys'/'global' are read from window ('type' function by default for keys), 'dom' selectors queried; 'when' = page | city (City tab open) | lazy (only when the site loaded that script). severity: break = the 3D game cannot work (boot stops with «Сайт обновился»), degrade = one feature degrades (console.warn + 'l3d:drift'). Keep in sync when the code starts relying on something new (docs/EXTENDING.md).
